JW Café ***this is how you do a buffet***
Apr 2026 • Solo
Start with the food. Across the board, it’s excellent. The seafood is a standout, but it’s not carrying the rest — everything is done to a high standard. The selection is extensive, the quality is consistent, and it actually delivers on what a premium buffet promises. You don’t just sample here, you settle in.

Then the service. Exemplary. Attentive without hovering, efficient without feeling rushed. Staff are sharp, proactive, and clearly know what they’re doing, which lifts the entire experience.

And that’s the difference. JW Café doesn’t feel like a typical buffet. It feels deliberate. Well run. Worth your time.

This is a standout. 150% recommend. A genuine jewel.

Good Effort, but Needs Improvement - 3.5/5 stars
Nov 2025 • Family
Our experience didn’t start very smoothly. Our family of 18 was seated in a room at the far end of the restaurant, quite far from the buffet area, which made the experience a bit inconvenient. However, both the manager and the staff did their best to assist us by bringing food to our table, even though it was a dinner buffet.
The buffet price was reasonable, especially since we are Marriott members and received the “5 pay 4” benefit.
One thing that really disappointed me was that the Wagyu beef rump listed on the menu was not available that evening. I had double-checked with the staff beforehand, and they confidently confirmed that it would be served. This was one of the main reasons I decided to move my children’s and grandchildren’s birthday dinner from another hotel to this one — as they were excited about having the Wagyu beef.
A few objective comments on the facilities: the restroom area near the dining room no longer feels new or luxurious, which is quite surprising for a restaurant located inside such a well-known hotel. The elevators also had an unpleasant smell and didn’t feel well-ventilated.
Overall, the manager and staff were helpful and attentive, but not as genuinely friendly as in some other hotels I’ve experienced — perhaps because we were a Vietnamese family.

Best and highest quality F&B in Saigon
Sep 2025 • Couples
The JW Marriot in HCMC is a regular spot for my wife and I. We have enjoyed many breakfast, lunches, and dinners there. 

The F&B choices, while not as many as other hotels, are of high quality. If you prefer quality over quantity, this is the place.

We also travel 25-30 times per year within Asia, Europe and the US, and this JW Marriott is near the top of the list in terms of dining experiences. 

Not only is the dining experience top notch, the service was impeccable. Friendly smiles from the attentive waiting staff. Special thanks to Ms. Thien Pham, the service manager, at Market 39. She and her team continue to do a phenomal job, and the reasons we have repeatedly visited Market 39.

Continue the great work!
